# UnifData

> UnifData is a unified business data workspace and CRM for service businesses — home services, contractors, and professional service companies. It organizes customers, jobs, follow-ups, and revenue into one industry-aware workspace, with an AI assistant (Vera) that reviews the business overnight and flags what needs attention.

UnifData replaces juggling a spreadsheet, a separate invoicing tool, and a personal phone for texts/emails with one connected system: customer records, sales pipeline, job tracking, follow-up reminders, and revenue all stay in sync automatically as work happens, whether it's entered by hand, imported from a spreadsheet, or synced from Jobber, QuickBooks, HubSpot, or Square.
